text: Nakulan and his wife Ganga holiday at [his family's sprawling ancestral mansion in Kerala|trigger|going back home], the Madampalli Tharavad, despite warnings that it is haunted. Legend says that 150 years ago a patriarch [murdered the court dancer Nagavalli and her lover|wrong|a life taken], and that her spirit is trapped in the locked southern wing. The sceptical Ganga [takes the keys and opens the forbidden room|rules|break the rule and pay], and soon apparitions appear, objects shatter and [her saree catches fire|images|fire, smoke and burning], until the family summons the psychiatrist Dr. Sunny Joseph.
